subtitle: Monthly horror picks for the mortally curious. One novel; all sinking their teeth into Vampires.

novels.title: Hungerstone
novels.author: Kat Dunn (2025)
novels.vibe: A seductive Victorian retelling of Carmilla about a repressed wife who finally gets to want something.
novels.summary: Ten years into a hollowed-out marriage to an ambitious steel magnate, Lenore relocates with her husband to the remote British moorlands, where a carriage accident brings the mysterious Carmilla into her life. As Carmilla awakens Lenore's long-suppressed hunger and rage, the novel becomes a gothic industrial-era vampire story about desire, class, and self-erasure.
novels.warnings: Violence, death, workplace injury, themes of repression and emotional neglect.

novels.title: Vampire Hunter D: The Rose Princess
novels.author: Hideyuki Kikuchi (1990, tr. English ed.)
novels.pages: Page count not reliably found — checked Goodreads/Amazon/B&N
novels.vibe: Pulpy, atmospheric Japanese dark-fantasy pulp about a wandering vampire hunter and a village that made a deal with the wrong noblewoman.
novels.summary: A young woman is about to be sacrificed to a vampiric Noblewoman ruling over a remote village, before a would-be hero's failed rescue draws in the legendary Vampire Hunter D. With the village's pact broken, D must face down the vampire's monstrous bodyguards to save the survivors — classic sword-and-fang dark fantasy from the long-running series.
novels.warnings: Violence, gore, body horror, sacrifice/ritual themes, monster combat.

novels.title: Let the Right One In
novels.author: John Ajvide Lindqvist (2004, tr. 2007)
novels.vibe: A grim, wintry Swedish suburb vampire novel that's as much about bullied-kid loneliness as it is about monsters.
novels.summary: Oskar, a bullied twelve-year-old in a bleak Stockholm suburb, befriends Eli, the strange new child next door who only comes out at night — right as a string of brutal murders starts up nearby. Their friendship, tender and unsettling in equal measure, unfolds alongside a much colder, uglier story about the adults around them and what Eli actually is.
novels.warnings: Child abuse, pedophilia (a major adult character), graphic violence, animal death, self-harm, body horror, bullying.

novels.title: A Dowry of Blood
novels.author: S.T. Gibson (2021)
novels.vibe: A lush, epistolary Dracula retelling about a vampire bride slowly realizing her marriage is a cage.
novels.summary: Constanta narrates centuries by her vampire master's side, tracing how she became his bride and helped him claim two more members for their immortal, tangled family across Europe. The gothic romance curdles as the story goes, exposing the abuse and control underneath the seduction.
novels.warnings: Intimate partner abuse (emotional, verbal, physical), gaslighting, self-harm, body horror, sexual content, references to sexual assault and child abuse (off-page).

novels.title: House of Hunger
novels.author: Alexis Henderson (2022)
novels.vibe: A dark, opulent gothic about a poor girl drawn into a noble household that literally feeds on its servants.
novels.summary: Marion leaves the slums to become a bloodmaid at the House of Hunger, a lavish estate where wealthy nobles are sustained by the blood of those in their service. Drawn deeper into the orbit of the house's ruler, Countess Lisavet, Marion starts uncovering a pattern of bloodmaids who vanished before her — and what's really happening within the house's walls.
novels.warnings: Blood/gore, death, violence, murder, themes of exploitation and class abuse.
